events.eventDescription: Function "windowChildren(scr->display, scr->rootWin, &nchildren)" modifies its argument, assigning 0 to "nchildren".
Expression "i", where "nchildren - 1U" is known to be equal to 4294967295, overflows the type of "i", which is type "int".

issueOccurrences.localEffect: The overflowed value due to arithmetic on constants is too small or unexpectedly negative, causing incorrect computations.
issueOccurrences.longDescription: Integer overflow occurs in arithmetic on constant operands
